notes.title: Little Problems Demo now available to play!
notes.content:
Everyday misunderstandings and minor inconveniences are here for you to solve! Help Mary get through her first day of university in our Little Problems demo at Next Fest.

From today, Monday February 24 until Monday March 3, you can play through the demo and get to know Mary and her family and friends. Explore why Mary is late for her first lecture, what grades everyone got and who broke Mary's favourite cup.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707261/3ab0e6b6855d0598e4bccdd1da99bf1319e497a4.jpg

Dive into the demo now and give us your thoughts in the comments below and on social media. And don't forget to give the game a wishlist!

~ Posh Cat Studio

🐦 Twitter/X
🦋 Bluesky
🎵 Tiktok


Solving a few mysteries (the FAQ!) 
🔍 How can I play Little Problems?
You can download the free download during Steam Next Fest to play the game. It's a point and click puzzle game so all you'll need is your mouse!

🔍 How many cases are in the demo?
The first three cases are in the demo; there will be 10 cases to piece together in the full game.

🔍  When is the full game out?
Little Problems will be out this year, 2025!
